restoration_note: The teaching describes how the new bud (a forming perception) is shaped, warmed, and adorned through the five elements of the natural mind under the Lord's ordering, but is also inundated by the shadow of Hyle (the self's energeia) where the soul has not laid off what it claimed. Most gaps are tightly constrained line-end/line-start splits of well-known compound words (ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ 'heat,' ϩⲓⲧⲟⲟⲧⲟⲩ 'through them,' ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲁⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ 'stumble' in Lyc., ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲏϩ 'which dwells,' ⲧⲉⲥϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'her shadow,' ⲡϣⲏⲛ 'the tree,' ⲍⲙⲱϩ 'warms,' ⲛⲧⲉ 'of'). The decorative ⲣⲏ marker pattern handles {0}/{1}. Only {2} is genuinely uncertain — a 3-letter verb in the molding/adorning sequence, which I propose as ⲣⲱⲧ 'cause to grow' but with low confidence.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor proposal: connector ⲛ between the molding-clause and the destroying-clause that follows in 5121 (ⲥⲉⲧⲉⲕⲁⲥ ⲁⲛ ⲍⲓⲧⲟⲟⲧⲟⲩ). Standard Lyc. coordinator.
Editor proposal: decorative ⲣⲏ marker (✦) matching the same ornamental marker at the head of this line and parallel placements in nearby lines. Non-lexical.

3-char verb in the sequence 'they are molded and they {2} … and they adorn it in the five elements.' ⲣⲱⲧ ('grow / cause to sprout') fits the agricultural register of the new-bud parable and the molding–growing–adorning triad. Trace pattern '.[..]' is compatible. Low certainty.
Editor proposal: completes ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ 'the heat' across the line break (ⲡⲍ- | -ⲙ becomes ⲡⲍ[ⲙⲁ]ⲙ). The heat–cold (ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ ... ⲡⲁⲣⲁϣ) elemental dyad is the structural pair of the section.
Single letter restoring ⲍⲙⲱϩ 'warms,' the verb paired antithetically with ⲡⲁⲣⲁϣ 'cold.' Same root as ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ in the previous line.
Single letter completing ⲡϣⲏⲛ 'the tree' (followed by ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ 'whole'). Lexicon: ⲡϣⲏⲛ = tree (perception/knowledge), the central image of the parable.
Editor proposal: completes ϩⲓⲧⲟⲟⲧⲟⲩ 'through them' (ϩⲓ- | [ⲧⲟ]ⲟⲧⲟⲩ), the same compound preposition used at line 2 (ⲍⲓⲧⲟⲟⲧⲟⲩ).
Editor proposal: line-end ⲛ of ⲥⲕⲁⲛ-, beginning the Lyc. orthography ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲁⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ (Greek σκανδαλίζειν 'stumble'). Continues into next line.
Editor proposal: continues ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲁⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ from previous line; Lyc. -ⲁⲁ- for Greek -δα-.
Editor proposal: relative-qualitative ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲏϩ 'which dwells' modifying ⲧϩⲩⲗⲏ — the energeia of the Hyle 'which dwells in them.' Standard Lyc. relative form of ⲟⲩⲱϩ.
Editor proposal: feminine possessive ⲧⲉⲥ- on ϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'her shadow' (i.e. Hyle's shadow). Confirmed by ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲥ- in the next line referring to the same shadow.
Editor proposal: completes ϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'shadow' split across the line (ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲥ-|[ϩⲁⲓⲃ]ⲉⲥ). Same word as previous line.
Editor proposal: standard genitive ⲛⲧⲉ binding ⲛ̄ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ to ⲛϣⲏⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ — 'the fruits of all the trees.'
